question: Can the published 2026 national freshwater-fish biogeography supplements be acquired with clear permission for national species-discovery work?

publisherFindings.dataAvailability: The publisher says data supporting the findings are provided in Supporting Information.
publisherFindings.tableS1: Publisher description: freshwater-fish taxon checklist with family/genus, presence data across catchment sites, ecological and nativity categories, notes, and a change log citing authorities. Figure S2 description reports 299 species in the full dataset and 79 in the obligate-primary-freshwater subset. The actual workbook cells, rows, citations and change log were not retrieved or inspected.
publisherFindings.tablesS2ToS4: Publisher description: 32 analysis catchment sites with site IDs, names, manuscript province assignments, catchment-centroid coordinates and environmental/climate variables. Centroids are analysis-site context, not species observation points or waterbody boundaries.
publisherFindings.tableS5: Publisher description: per-province sample-coverage and Chao 2 richness estimates; underlying values were not rechecked in this access follow-up.

institutionalRepository.finding: The accessible DMMMSU item page lists one 1.28 MB article PDF and no supporting spreadsheet files.

rights.publisherNotice: The Wiley article page displays an all-rights-reserved notice, including text-and-data-mining rights.
rights.supplementSpecificTerms: No separate license or written permission for redistribution or public-app use was established for the supporting workbooks.
rights.decision: Do not copy, publish, normalize into public Bangwit rows, or infer the unseen workbook contents. Seek written permission and an explicit license or terms first.

nextAction: Use the unsent request draft to seek the official workbooks, version details and written reuse terms. Do not make regional work wait for a reply: continue with independently accessible, rights-cleared freshwater sources and named-waterbody surveys in the existing Luzon-first order.

sources.supports: Official article page: publication date, national framework, data-availability statement, descriptions of Tables S1-S5, 299 full-dataset and 79 primary-freshwater species in the Figure S2 description, and the publisher rights notice.
